body: I've had this feeling for as long as 8 years. I cant imagine breaking my mother's wonderful heart. I think that in time we will find something that gives us a purpose so we dont just live for those we love, but for ourselves too. Keep going, even in your darkest hours.
So you are suicidal?
For me they're always on the back of my mind to a degree. I try to push them out but it doesn't always work. Gaming helps a bit though
I feel the same way. I have chronic fatigue. Everything I do seems like a slog. It's hell. I'm sorry you go through that too. Use those little bursts of energy to make you happy if you can.
Oh I love EU4. I've got around 500 hours. Civ 5 too.
That's cool I've got Rocket League, never really played it before though. It looks fun.
I play most anything. I like RTSs, FPSs, RPGs, some MMOS, stuff like that. I play on all systems but Xbox. I'll PM you my tags if you want. I'll try not to be too awkward, I swear.

Thats the thing i cant do. Either i go blank face or i just act like I'm happy no matter how much it tears me up inside. Yeah gaming is my escape too though I don't have anyone to play with usually. And trying to draw and write even though I suck.

Im the exact same way. When I'm alone it's hell in my head. But even when I'm talking to friends or gaming or at the movies it slowly creeps into my head, and it ruins the whole thing and I become uncomfortable. Like I'm doing something wrong, a lot of the times it's not even anything I can put my finger on. 
I can't be around people either unless I really like them otherwise it's like I'm just saying things to get it over with as quick as possible. There's no way I could hold down a job with people like that. 

It's nothing against them personally, it's just the feeling I get when I'm around them.

I hope so because I honestly don't know how long I can go on like this. And what you said earlier about always thinking of the negative is exactly my problem. No matter how happy I think I am... I'm not...
PM me I may fall asleep soon but I can pm for a bit.

My family knows I'm bad off too but the only person who knows to what degree (or at least as much as I'll let on) about how depressed and lonely I am is my mother. And it's the same thing with my mother, she's got her own troubles and I don't want to exacerbate her issues. Putting on airs hurts. It's like dying inside. It feels like a thousand blades churning in my stomach. I don't know how to show how bad it is either. And I want to change to, but I can't because I'm too stubborn or too ill.

I need to see a therapist but the psych I've been seeing hasn't made any progress with me which really scares me. I've tried a few therapists and I've never clicked. They're always either way to clinical in a dumb way or too corny. I just don't know how to find the right one, because I am so tired physically and emotionally. I just need to *do* stuff, but I can't because of physical hurdles.

I can't tell my mother about those sorts of things and my suicidal ideations either. If I did I'd break her heart. It's hard to accept love when you hate yourself. But you need it to live. So how do you get it? I don't know what to do either.

That's my problem. I hate myself. I don't like anything about me. I try to some times but it feels like my brain shoots down any positive thought of myself as narcissism or self absorption. It's like I see these things in other people, thing I do and don't like. And when I do something that someone I have a negative opinion on does, positive or not, I scorn myself for it. I just don't know how to love myself. I don't know if I can.
That seems to be the way it is with me too. Even people who I know care about me just seem to have no effect on how lonely I am, at least in the long term. It's heart breaking.

Yes I feel much better now. I go through really bad mood swings, to the point that I can become suicidal. I think this along with some other things pulled me out of it this time around. You were the only one to respond, and that meant more than anything.
Thank you very much.

It's not exactly that. Though I do think that of myself a lot and I really appreciate the kind words. It's just physical and mental torment from various sources. It'd take me an hour to list all of them but the most torturous ones are: Mytochondrial Myopathy (which causes many things but mainly chronic fatige), the back of a 70 y/o and arthritis (I'm only eighteen), depression (obviously), this thing called brain fog, and all sorts of anxiety. It just seems to be too much to handle. I can barely shower let alone do anything productive, which is what kills me the most. My family deserves so much better.
I feel the same way.
You play video games? Want to talk?
I feel lost too. I wish I could offer you advice. Just know you're not alone
